hierarchy.auditorSplit: The auditor uses a different provider.

hierarchy.title: Model hierarchy

permission.deniedRun: Stopped: you denied {command}. Nothing was installed.
permission.title: Install permission
permission.waitingHold: Waiting for your permission to run {command}.
permission.why: It installs packages the task needs to continue.

run.emptyPlan: Nothing was built — the plan had no parts. Say what you want built, for example: “{example}”
run.emptyPlanExample: Add a contact page with a test.

diagnostics.purpose: Developer screens that read live app state.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

folder.hint: The folder this project works in.

provider.localNote: Runs on this PC, no key

steps.oneClickTeam: Create your team in one click

team.needProvider: Connect a provider first — the team needs one.

codeTests.body: code tests = the project's own test suite.
codeTests.title: Code tests

localTests.body: local tests = catalog tests the app runs locally.
localTests.title: Local tests

migration.done: Migration finished. Old copies were kept.
migration.keepsOldCopies: Your old data and credentials are moved into the app, and the old copies are kept.
migration.title: Moving your data

projectView.blockedNote: Blocked at run end: the row waits on a failed guard. Open the Errors tab for the served reason.

cost.limitExplainer: Total N is the budget limit: spending stops when it is reached.

projectView.noLive: No live agent rows right now.

purpose.aiUsage: Served agent activity and current live presence.
purpose.audits: Served counts plus rows that need attention.
purpose.chat: Talk to the project: messages, runs and results in one stream.
purpose.cloudAi: Work running with cloud providers, one row per agent.
purpose.cost: Money spent, reserved and left, against the budget limit.
purpose.errors: Only served failures: blocked agents and failed tasks.
purpose.localAi: Work running on this machine, one row per agent.
purpose.models: Which model did which role, from served records.
purpose.overview: Key facts for this project, each from a served record.
purpose.reports: Readable totals from served records; the raw export stays behind Show more.
purpose.routing: Why the router chose this model, from the stored decision.
purpose.runs: One row per package with agents, time and the install note.
purpose.tasks: Every task with its current status and creation date.
purpose.tests: Latest run results: code tests, AI checks and human verdicts, one row per test.
purpose.time: Wall-clock seconds per package from the served ledger.
purpose.tokens: Tokens used per role and model; money lives on the Cost tab.

routing.autoWhy: Auto: cheapest known price among connected providers.

runs.keyMissing: The key for '{provider}' is not available. Connect it again.

tokens.explainer: Tokens used per role and model, from served records only. No money here.

folder.missing: Project folder not found: {path}. Choose another folder in Projects.

kbDetach.empty: No knowledge base is attached to this project.
kbDetach.title: Attached knowledge bases

list.duplicate: A project with this name already exists.
list.subtitle: Every project in one list; open one to work.
list.title: Projects

reports.subtitle: Latest reports with files, ready to open.
reports.title: Reports

row.leaveTitle: Leave: archive this project and remove it from the list
row.stopTitle: Stop: pause this project here only; the server keeps no record of it

tests.emptyHow: No test run has started for this project yet. Start a run for the latest plan, then this tab shows counters and one row per test.
tests.explainer: Runs = agent work; code tests = the project's own test suite; local tests = catalog tests the app runs locally. This tab shows the latest run: served counters and one row per test. It never changes settings.

local.body: Catalog checks this machine runs before spend. One switch only.
local.label: Local tests
local.title: Local tests

tests.title: Tests
tests.autoLine: Nothing to paste: tests run by themselves after the agents' work. Code tests run by script, no AI; AI tests by a model; human tests ask you. Your own base can be added in Settings.

why_this_model.detail: Each model row carries its own reason. Open a routing decision to read why this model was chosen.
why_this_model.title: Why this model

chat.contributorWarning: Contributor tier: prompts and completions may be used by Meta to train future models (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits).
chat.label: Chat model

connect.failedGeneric: Connect failed before the server answered.
connect.getKey: Get a key from your {label} account.
connect.hintMismatch: This key does not match the expected format.
connect.localFound: Local server answered: found {count} models. Save to connect.
connect.localNotRunning: Local server is not running. Start {label} first, then Check again.
connect.needOneModel: Tick at least one model, or Cancel to keep the current list.
connect.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh the live list — keeping the last list.
connect.refusedKey: The provider refused this key. Paste the full key again.
connect.retryHint: Re-paste the full key and make sure you picked the matching provider.
connect.saveFailed: The key was not saved: the store gave no answer.
connect.storeNote: The key stays in your Windows store.
connect.title: Connect {label}
connect.unknownModelsNote: Some models are not in the capability base.
connect.unreachable: The provider is slow or unreachable. Your key is saved. Press Connect again.

disconnect.refused: Refused: secret {secret} is not bound to provider {provider}.
disconnect.title: Disconnect {label}

leftover.inUseTitle: In use by a live provider

page.noneEnabled: None enabled — open Manage models to choose.
page.title: Providers

any-openai-compatible.keyHint: Any OpenAI-style key or token for your server.

lm-studio.keyHint: Local server: usually no key is needed.

ollama.keyHint: Local server: usually no key is needed.

rolepool.emptyPoolHint: Pick at least one model: an empty pool never saves.
rolepool.helpAuto: Route on task fit, price and quality. No fixed model.
rolepool.helpPinned: Always use this one model for the role.
rolepool.helpPool: Choose from these models by strategy.
rolepool.strategyFallbackOrder: Try in order, fall back on failure
rolepool.strategyHelpAuto: Pool members are chosen automatically on task fit, price and quality.

rolepool.strategyHelpSplitParallel: A local draft is verified in the cloud.
rolepool.strategySplitParallel: Draft locally, verify in the cloud

setup.hint: Choose a model per role, or leave a role on Automatic.

appearance.needItNow: Only to switch between dark and light themes.
appearance.title: Appearance

capabilityDb.needItNow: Only to inspect the evidence behind a model.
capabilityDb.purpose: What each model is evidenced to do.
capabilityDb.title: Capability Database

general.needItNow: Open this only when the defaults feel wrong.
general.resetDone: The setup was reset. The wizard will show again.
general.title: General
general.whereText: Language switches here. Theme lives under Appearance; models and routing live under Models and Routing.

grants.empty: No install grants for this project. Choose “For this project” on the next install ask to add one.
grants.title: Install grants

hub.howItWorksPurpose: How the app carries out tasks step by step.
hub.migrationPurpose: Move data over from an older version.

index.needItNow: Open only the section you need.
index.subtitle: Defaults live here; open only the page you need.
index.title: Settings

localAi.empty: There are no local presets. Add Ollama or LM Studio to connect on this machine.
localAi.needItNow: Only when you want work to stay on this machine.
localAi.noCapability: No capability data for {model}; it can still be used.
localAi.title: Local LLM

localbench.decisionEmpty: Each finished run is recorded here.
localbench.durationWarning: This run may take a while. The PC stays busy until it finishes.
localbench.loadWarning: High PC load expected. Close other heavy programs first.
localbench.modelsEmpty: No local models found in this folder yet.
localbench.needItNow: Only to compare local models before a long run.
localbench.purpose: Measure local models on this PC before using them.
localbench.runNeedsScan: Run is disabled until a scan finishes.
localbench.title: Local benchmark

models.needItNow: Only to review or change the model list.
models.purpose: Which models the app may use.
models.title: Models

optimization.needItNow: Only to tune spending or speed.
optimization.title: Optimization

project.limitsBlank: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
project.needItNow: Only the project owner touches risk acceptance.
project.offloadHint: Routine worker parts hand over to a cheaper agent when the switch is on.
project.parallel: Parts running at the same time
project.stepsHint: Each limit caps how many steps one task or chat reply may take.
project.title: Project

qacatalog.needItNow: Only to inspect which tests the app runs.
qacatalog.purpose: Which test catalog the app runs, and its versions.
qacatalog.title: Test catalog

risk.label: I accept the risk

routing.needItNow: Only when a routing choice surprises you.
routing.title: Routing

validation.pinnedBindingRequired: A pinned profile needs both a provider and a model.

automations.title: Automations
automations.purpose: Small jobs on a schedule, a number or an event - every run recorded.
automations.needItNow: Open it when the same instruction repeats: checkpoint, pause, notify.

context.subtitle: Tokens used of the model window.
context.title: Context

closing.runWorking: Run still working. Leave this page?

sidebar.resultsHint: Select a project to see its reports.

creator.subtitle: Start here: one message creates the first project and task.
creator.title: New task

tab.fallbackNote: Off means the watcher never uses cloud models.
tab.looksHang: Looks for hung agents with no fresh heartbeat
tab.subtitle: Independent watch over agents: state, journal and rules.

page.approvalNote: Restart once, pause and stop need your approval before they act.
page.evaluateOffNote: Turn the card on to evaluate.
page.noBackendNote: No backend rule for this card; evaluation runs on the guard and tamper cards.
page.presetCautiousLine: Only the hang card stays on.
page.presetStrictLine: Hang, guard and tamper cards on.
page.doNotClose: Do not close while in use

fxauto.purpose: Automations run small jobs for you on a schedule, on a number, or on an event. Every run is recorded; nothing runs while the stop switch is on.
fxauto.rulesEmpty: No rules yet. Start from a template or build a new rule.
fxauto.builderStrongNote: Strong actions run only after you approve them below.
fxauto.needProject: Open a project to manage its rules.
fxauto.pausedRefused: Automations are stopped - turn the stop switch off first.
fxauto.turnedOffRefused: This rule is turned off - turn it on to run it.

do.notify: sends a notice to the journal

results.reread: Context re-read for {name}: {register} register rows, {checkpoints} checkpoints.
